confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors are moderately supported by 2026 General Luna guide ranges and national Philippine aggregates, though sources conflict and several come from accommodation operators. Beer varies widely by venue type. Cocktail is guide-based with a beer-relationship check. Wine glass has no usable Siargao per-glass price, so it is set from the local beer relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not from searches, live booking pages or current listings. FX is the 18 Nov 2026 RBA observation seen in search results; the RBA page was not opened directly and no 19 Nov value was found.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are based on General Luna (Siargao) guide ranges, cross-checked against Philippine national and Manila aggregates. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for Philippine surf-island towns.
